hypothesis: The last-transformer-layer updates in v016 prune correct melody events along with false positives. Freezing every transformer layer and updating only the output normalization and projection may preserve acoustic evidence while changing token probabilities.

budget.interpretation: Compare with these same v016 steps only. The shorter predeclared run budget is not evidence about v016 steps 25-40.
